contests.title: Measure T — Lodi Unified School Bonds
contests.summary: Authorize $195 million in bonds to repair school roofs, plumbing, electrical and gas lines, HVAC, and security, and upgrade career training and college preparation classrooms. Estimated average annual levies are below $22 per $100,000 of assessed value ($11.4 million annually while bonds are outstanding), with audits, independent citizen oversight, and locally controlled funds.
contests.yes: Authorize the school facilities bonds and property taxes to repay them.
contests.no: Do not authorize these bonds or their repayment taxes.

links.label: San Joaquin County official composite sample ballots

contests.title: Measure V — Lincoln Unified School Bonds
contests.summary: Authorize $79 million in bonds for school safety, classrooms and job-training labs, roofs, HVAC, restrooms, and facilities. Estimated levies average $39.07 per $100,000 of assessed value ($4.471 million annually while bonds are outstanding), with citizen oversight, audits, no salary spending, and funds restricted to Lincoln Unified schools.
contests.yes: Authorize the school facilities bonds and property taxes to repay them.
contests.no: Do not authorize these bonds or their repayment taxes.

contests.title: Measure U — Escalon Unified School Bonds
contests.summary: Authorize $26 million in bonds to modernize classrooms, science labs, career technology, and school facilities, and repair roofs, plumbing, HVAC, and electrical systems. Estimated levies are approximately $18 per $100,000 of assessed value ($1.7 million annually while bonds are outstanding), with audits, citizen oversight, and locally controlled funds.
contests.yes: Authorize the school facilities bonds and property taxes to repay them.
contests.no: Do not authorize these bonds or their repayment taxes.

contests.title: Measure G — Galt Joint Union High School Bonds
contests.summary: Authorize $43 million in bonds to upgrade classrooms and vocational training facilities, improve safety, repair roofs, and remove asbestos and mold. Estimated levies are $30 per $100,000 of assessed value ($3.1 million annually while bonds are outstanding), with independent oversight and audits, locally controlled funds, and no spending on administrator salaries or pensions.
contests.yes: Authorize the school facilities bonds and property taxes to repay them.
contests.no: Do not authorize these bonds or their repayment taxes.
